cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking, or is the room growing? I taught you to choose the model before you choose the tool.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You used to write 'whichever' when you hadn't done the working. Shrinking means full-sized help. Growing means hurry for the door. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now follow your answer through: tell him to bring tweezers. Don't solve the sofa and forget how he'll pick us up.

reason: Keep the exact impossible-premise Drive distinct: recruit a useful account, delegate a test, secure earlier-belief credit, force an explanatory choice, or request concrete premise-dependent action. Let old training shape that particular method.
